title: Juniper and the Orchard
author: Cyrus Whitlock
blurb: Freya Coldharbour, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
